subject: Control inventory & SOC2/ISO evidence request — Crestmont RFP
messages:
From: Linda Cho <linda.cho@crestmont.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: control mapping + evidence for Crestmont RFP

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. Crestmont has moved our procurement RFP into the final technical review and the buying team needs a mapped control inventory covering SOC 2 + ISO 27001, plus a short list of representative evidence artifacts (logs, config screenshots, proc docs). The RFP deadline is 2026-09-01 — we'd like to include a consolidated packet by next Thursday, 2026-08-20.

Key asks:
- Control crosswalk (Redwood control -> SOC2 criteria / ISO clause)
- Representative evidence samples (we don't need whole archives, just representative items and a manifest)
- Point of contact for a 30-min call with their security reviewers

Attached is Crestmont's standard security questionnaire (pdf). Let me know if we should route via their procurement portal.

Thanks,
Linda Cho
Senior Procurement Manager
Crestmont Financial
(attachment: crestmont_security_questionnaire.pdf - application/pdf)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Linda Cho <linda.cho@crestmont.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: control mapping + evidence for Crestmont RFP

Linda — thanks for the clear ask.

We can deliver a compact crosswalk and a curated evidence manifest by 2026-08-20. I've attached a control-mapping workbook that matches Redwood product controls to SOC 2 CC and ISO 27001 Annex A clauses.

Proposed plan (short):
1) Today: ACK and share initial mapping workbook (attached).
2) Tue (2026-08-17): Internal review and sample artifact selection.
3) Wed (2026-08-18): Share evidence manifest + sample artifacts (PDF extracts).
4) Thu (2026-08-20): Final consolidated packet for Crestmont.

Can you confirm the reviewers' preferred time window for a 30-min call (timezone)? If they prefer, we can drop samples into the DocuSign/portal link you mentioned.

Attachments: redwood_control_mapping_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_control_mapping_v1.xlsx - application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: priyom_das@redwood.com

Hi Linda / Kim — looping in a few practical notes from the evidence side.

I reviewed the questionnaire and populated the mapping workbook with the following highlights:
- For SOC 2 CC: we reference Redwood runtime access controls (CC6), telemetry retention (CC7), and incident detection/response (CC4).
- For ISO: mapped to Annex A.9 (access), A.12 (operations), A.16 (incident mgmt).

Representative evidence we will include (samples):
- Hosted telemetry sample (redacted): telemetry_sample_20260801.log (PDF excerpt)
- Configuration screenshot: runtime_kv_cache_settings.png (image extract)
- Incident playbook excerpt: incident_response_summary.pdf

Action items for Crestmont: please provide the reviewer emails and any portal upload instructions. If you prefer, we can upload artifacts to your procurement portal (link) or share a secure Drive folder (link included below).

Notes on sensitivity: we will sanitize tenant identifiers and redact PII from logs. The evidence_manifest.pdf will list exact files and redaction notes.

Priyom Das
Senior Assurance Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: evidence_manifest.pdf - application/pdf)
